responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s variance analysis over TyTy types. This file provides the per-crate CrateCtx entry points, defines the Variance semilattice operations and composition rules, walks ADT fields to generate constraints on lifetime and type parameters, solves those constraints to a fixpoint, and answers follow-up queries such as the inferred variance of a generic ADT parameter, the variances and regions mentioned inside an arbitrary type, and the parent-region indices reachable from a specific ADT field.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation behind the variance-analysis interface: it provides the out-of-line CrateCtx and Variance method bodies and the internal crate-wide/visitor machinery that builds, propagates, and solves variance constraints over ADT fields and substitutions. Unlike the header, this .cc file contains the executable analysis logic rather than just the API and type declarations.
